text:
sam.lang: FYI incident in eu-inference — latency spikes observed on kvcache host during the EU canary. Please pause the EU rollout and pin canary instances.
deploy-bot: :warning: Pausing rollout for release v2.15.0 across eu-west. All queued deploys for this release are put on hold. Runbook: https://runbook.internal/redwood/inference-canary-issues
maria.ops: thanks. can we revert canary to v2.14.3 to stop the noise? current canaries started at 12:03 UTC.
alex.k: I'm +1 to rollback canaries. I'll trigger a controlled rollback; DB schema is compatible with the older version.
sam.lang: if we rollback, pin traffic to stable across prod/preview. use flag `--pin-version v2.14.3` when triggering the job.
ops_jordan: propose reschedule full rollout to 02:00 UTC tomorrow (low traffic). canary re-run at 01:30. any objections?
maria.ops: no objections. set canary window 15m. health checks: 200 OK, p95 latency < 120ms, errors < 0.5%.
deploy-bot: rollback job #4501 queued by alex.k -> executing. Canary instances will be replaced with v2.14.3. ETA ~12m.
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Incident INC-2026-345 opened by sam.lang. Summary: EU canary latency spike during v2.15.0 rollout. Channel created: #inc-2026-345.
alex.k: rollback started, logs:
```sh
kubectl rollout undo deploy/inference-canary -n eu-west --to-revision=3
```
maria.ops: I'll update the release calendar and the release notes draft: note the rollback and delayed rollout. Also pinging customers@redwood.com with the heads up.
sam.lang: once rollback is green (ops_jordan please confirm) we'll schedule a short postmortem and pick a new release candidate.
ops_jordan: rollback completed, canaries stable at v2.14.3. Health checks passing across eu-west-1 and eu-west-2. Creating reschedule PR for 02:00 UTC window.
deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: Job #4501 completed. Rollback success. Release v2.15.0 remains on hold. To resume: `/deploy resume v2.15.0 --approved-by sam.lang,maria.ops`.
maria.ops: thanks everyone — saving notes to #eng-releases and tagging PMs for the reschedule.
